posts.hook: The company behind the AI chip boom is now investigating its own CEO
posts.caption: nvidia's board opened an independent investigation into jensen huang after he admitted an affair with a suspected chinese intelligence asset, deepseek's agent app reports 1.54m daily users, outlook now rejects mail from domains without dmarc. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Nvidia's board opens an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang
slides.desc: The CEO at the center of chip export controls is under a formal governance probe.

slides.title: Trump says Huang should stay as Nvidia CEO, calling him a "fine person"
slides.desc: Washington is backing the CEO while a classified memo about the relationship surfaces.

slides.title: DeepSeek's open-source agent app reports ==1.54M== daily users in under three months
slides.desc: Company figures: about 60M tokens per user per day shows how heavy agent use is.

slides.title: A Commerce AI safety unit was reportedly asked to report to a White House office
slides.desc: AP sources raise independence concerns for CAISSI.

terms.gloss: the US Commerce Department's AI safety center

slides.title: Outlook.com now rejects email from domains without DMARC
slides.desc: Senders without it lose mail outright instead of landing in spam.

terms.gloss: a policy that lets domains prove their email is really theirs
